title: journal_append output (Receipt)
description: Receipt envelope returned by an append (catalog shape `Receipt`), mirroring the RCX receipt envelope: BLAKE3 content hash, optional ed25519 signature, optional signer key id. Advertise-only per RCX Session-Handshake v1; the field set is open (additive).

hash.description: Lowercase hex of the 32-byte BLAKE3 hash over the appended entry's canonical bytes.

signature.description: Lowercase hex of the 64-byte ed25519 signature, when the journal signer is configured.

signer_kid.description: Key id of the signing key, when signed.
